bottleneck.description: Largest North American welding equipment/consumables supplier; competes head-to-head with ITW/Miller, ESAB, Kemppi.

dependency.key_customers: Heavy industry, construction, shipyards, automotive welding cells, energy
dependency.key_suppliers: Steel/wire raw materials, electronics for inverters

editorial.notes: Lincoln has ~18% global welding share and strong brand, but the welding equipment and consumables market is structurally competitive with multiple credible alternatives (ITW/Miller, ESAB, Fronius, Panasonic, Daihen). Switching is operationally easy; consumables interchange across vendors. No sole-source choke-point.
